scope: Direct-exit Linux gate of the entity scan cutover (ENTITY_CANDIDATE, third slice): compiled C, Rust and the model-provider protocol changed. Every step is a direct child whose exit was read on the next line; one combined log. Not a native, Windows or retail run: the campaign scan loop in en_cllsn.c is engine C exercised only natively; the host decisions are exercised through a differential against a TRANSCRIPTION of the original scan.

new_checks.entity_candidate_host: 8 tests: a contract per branch of the original scan and a differential of the whole scan over 400 generated worlds x 6 segments (quarter-unit coordinates so boundary equalities occur): same entity and equal transcripts of UPDATED reads, terrain questions and narrow-phase poses, bit for bit
new_checks.entity_dialogue: 170 expectations of the campaign half of the dialogue (the real mb_hostentity.h against a scripted host)
new_checks.entity_host_guard: 4 tests: the ordinary module holds none of the original decisions, the original profile keeps them
new_checks.dc_bridge_and_engine_callback: 2 + 2 tests: the 42 facts cross bit for bit, every decision comes back with its state and exact pose, malformed and refused answers stop by marker
